tasks.title: Remove backend tool name whitelist
tasks.description: Remove the isKnownToolName whitelist in session-transcript-service.ts so original tool names are preserved. Adjust inferNormalizedToolName to only emit 'unknown' when no name clues exist in metadata or input.
acceptanceCriteria: Tools like webfetch, task, skill, question no longer normalize to 'unknown'
Existing known tools (read, write, bash, etc.) still normalize correctly
hasUnknownTools flag is still set when truly unidentifiable
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The whitelist was a premature optimization. Removing it lets the frontend decide how to display tools.

tasks.title: Add frontend tool input summary functions
tasks.description: Add getToolLabel and getToolArgs pure functions that extract human-readable descriptions and argument tags from arbitrary tool inputs. Handle common fields like description, query, url, filePath, command, pattern, etc.
acceptanceCriteria: getToolLabel extracts meaningful subtitle for webfetch (url), task (description), skill (name), search (query), etc.
getToolArgs returns array of key argument strings
Functions handle malformed JSON gracefully (return undefined / empty array)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Display text is a presentation concern — keep it in the frontend.

tasks.title: Redesign GenericToolCard with rich display
tasks.description: Redesign GenericToolCard to display an icon, 'Called {toolName}' header, dynamic subtitle from getToolLabel, and argument tags from getToolArgs. Keep raw JSON accessible via collapsible section but not as the primary view.
acceptanceCriteria: GenericToolCard shows icon + header + subtitle + arg tags for any tool
Raw input/output remains accessible via expand button
Failed tools still show error state clearly
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This is the highest-impact frontend change — most 'unknown' tools become readable.

tasks.title: Enhance SummaryToolCard with dynamic running subtitles
tasks.description: Update SummaryToolCard to use getToolLabel for richer parameter extraction. Replace static 'running...' text with dynamic subtitle derived from tool input (e.g., file path, search query).
acceptanceCriteria: Running tools show dynamic subtitle instead of static 'running...'
Completed tools show extracted parameters in summary line
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Also improves the experience for whitelisted tools like read/grep/glob.

tasks.title: Align live tool inference with backend normalization
tasks.description: Update useSessionTranscript.ts to trust backend normalizedName more and reduce frontend-only inference. Ensure live and historical tool names agree after backend whitelist removal.
acceptanceCriteria: Live streaming tools show same names as historical replay
No orphan 'unknown running...' entries from inference mismatch
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Critical for the 'live and historical views agree' spec invariant.

tasks.title: Compact context tool grouping with per-type counts
tasks.description: Refine ContextGroupCard in SessionTranscriptView.tsx to show compact summary with per-tool-type counts (e.g., 'Gathering context · read 3 · search 2 · list 1') and reduce expanded detail noise.
acceptanceCriteria: Context groups show type counts in collapsed header
Expanded view lists individual tools cleanly
Mixed context/non-context sequences group correctly
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Depends on correct tool classification from T-001.

tasks.title: End-to-end integration verification
tasks.description: Verify the complete flow: backend normalization, frontend display, live streaming, and historical replay all produce consistent tool cards with no 'unknown' entries for previously-whitelisted tools.
acceptanceCriteria: Session with webfetch/task/skill tools shows meaningful cards, not 'unknown'
Context tools group compactly with type counts
Running tools show dynamic subtitles
Live and historical views agree on tool names and grouping
Raw data remains accessible via expand
npm test passes
npm run build passes
tasks.output: Integration test results and verified UI behavior
tasks.notes: Final validation before marking the change complete.
